description: For every finite selection of requirements from \(\{p_n:n\in\mathbb N\}\cup\{\neg\bigwedge_{n\in\mathbb N}p_n\}\), there is an unrequired atom \(p_k\) such that making \(p_k\) false and all other atoms true satisfies every selected requirement.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.PropositionalCompactness.finite_infinite_requirement_witness
  (Δ : Finset Lemmatheca.Entry.PropositionalCompactness.InfiniteRequirement) :
  ∃ k,
    Lemmatheca.Entry.PropositionalCompactness.InfiniteRequirement.positive k ∉ Δ ∧
      ∀ A ∈ Δ,
        Lemmatheca.Entry.PropositionalCompactness.SatisfiesInfinite
          (Lemmatheca.Entry.PropositionalCompactness.missingAtomValuation k) A
